stories.title: Two killed, five wounded as drone fragments hit passenger bus in Crimea
stories.summary: Three of the injured are in critical, and the remaining two - in moderately severe condition
article_sentences: Fragments of a downed drone have hit a passenger bus in Sevastopol, killing two people and wounding five, governor Mikhail Razvozhayev wrote on Telegram.
"Our air defense forces and mobile fire teams continue to repel the Ukrainian attack on Sevastopol.
Unfortunately, deaths and injuries have already been reported," he said.
"Fragments of a downed drone hit a passenger bus."
"As a result, the bus caught fire," he continued.
"According to preliminary information, two people have been killed and five sustained wounds and burns."
Three of the injured are in critical, and the remaining two - in moderately severe condition, the governor said.
"Rescuers and doctors are working at the scene.
The wounded are receiving medical care," the governor said.
Later, the official announced that the attack had been repelled.
"Our military, air crews and mobile fire teams have repelled the latest large-scale attack on Sevastopol.
